$comment: Contract for codex exec --output-schema. OpenAI strict mode requires EVERY property in an object to be listed in `required` when additionalProperties:false, even ones that may be empty — verified 2026-09-11 against codex-cli 0.154.0 (omitting one field on findings.items 400'd with invalid_json_schema). Use empty string "" / empty array, never omit a key.

summary.description: 1-3 sentences: what was reviewed and the overall verdict rationale.

verdict.description: approve = no P0/P1; approve_with_changes = only P2/P3; reject = at least one P0 or P1.

severity.description: P0=security/data-loss/catastrophic, P1=serious functional bug, P2=functional/maintainability, P3=minor improvement.

file.description: Repo-relative path. Empty string if not applicable (e.g. plan-level finding).

location.description: Function/line/section. Empty string if not applicable.

problem.description: What is wrong, stated as a claim.

scenario.description: Concrete failing scenario: inputs/state -> wrong output/crash/data loss.

recommended_fix.description: Concrete suggested fix, not just 'handle this better'.
